site.slogan: Empowering Youth for Green, Digital (Twin) & Social Entrepreneurship
site.aciklama: An Erasmus+ KA220-YOU cooperation partnership: seven organisations from six countries empowering young people for green, social and digital entrepreneurship.
genel.hata: The operation could not be completed.
anasayfa.baslik: Empowering Youth for Green, Digital and Social Entrepreneurship
anasayfa.giris: E-YOUTHPRENEUR is a 24-month Erasmus+ cooperation partnership bringing together seven organisations from six countries to strengthen the green, social and digital entrepreneurship competences of young people aged 17-30.
anasayfa.ilerleme.baslik: Time elapsed in the project schedule
anasayfa.yaklasan.aciklama: A summary of the next milestones. See the activity calendar for the full programme.
anasayfa.yaklasan.bos: There are no upcoming activities scheduled at the moment.
anasayfa.amac.metin: To empower young people in green and social entrepreneurship and enhance their skills for creating sustainable businesses.
anasayfa.hedef.1: Improve young entrepreneurs' expertise in green and social entrepreneurship
anasayfa.hedef.2: Equip young people with essential skills for social and green businesses
anasayfa.hedef.3: Foster entrepreneurial mindsets among job-seeking youth
anasayfa.hedef.4: Raise awareness of green and social entrepreneurship
anasayfa.hedef.5: Strengthen collaboration between young entrepreneurs and industry
anasayfa.cikti.aciklama: All results will be published free of charge and in open access.
anasayfa.cikti.1.metin: A comparative scientific report identifying the key challenges and opportunities in green, social and digital entrepreneurship for young people.
anasayfa.cikti.2.metin: An open-access guide compiling innovative and transferable entrepreneurship models for youth workers, academics and NGOs.
anasayfa.cikti.3.metin: A transferable project format guiding young entrepreneurs from problem identification through to creative solutions.
anasayfa.cikti.4.metin: A self-paced entrepreneurship module with interactive content that also strengthens digital skills.
anasayfa.cikti.5.metin: A set of practical tools and methods ready to be used directly in youth work.
anasayfa.cikti.6.metin: Findings and recommendations to inform policy development in GSD entrepreneurship.
anasayfa.ortaklar.aciklama: Seven organisations from six countries, coordinated by Ankara Hacı Bayram Veli University.
anasayfa.ispaketleri.aciklama: The project runs across four work packages; each is tracked in the calendar with its own activities and results.
anasayfa.kapsayicilik.metin: All activities are designed so that young people with fewer opportunities, job seekers and participants from diverse backgrounds can take part on equal terms. Content is offered in several languages, visual materials carry alternative text, and online participation remains open to those who cannot attend in person.
altbilgi.feragat: Funded by the European Union. Views and opinions expressed are however those of the author(s) only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA). Neither the European Union nor EACEA can be held responsible for them.

wp.WP1.ozet: Coordination, quality assurance, risk management and monitoring. Four committees — Project Management & Finance, Dissemination & Communication, Quality Assurance & Risk Analysis, Monitoring & Evaluation — steer the project from start to finish.
wp.WP2.ad: WP2 · Needs Analysis & Good Practices E-Book
wp.WP2.baslik: Needs Analysis Report and Innovative Pathways: Green-Social & Digital Entrepreneurship Good Practices E-Book
wp.WP2.ozet: Establishes an evidence base on the needs of young people in green, social and digital entrepreneurship and compiles transferable good practices in an open-access e-book.
wp.WP3.ad: WP3 · Project Format & Online Training Module
wp.WP3.baslik: Designing an Entrepreneurship Project Format for Skill-Development and the GSD Entrepreneurship Online Training Module
wp.WP3.ozet: Develops a project format that guides young entrepreneurs, together with an interactive online training module open to self-paced learning.
wp.WP4.baslik: Piloting and Implementation of the Entrepreneurship Project Format, Final Conference, Dissemination and Multiplier Events
wp.WP4.ozet: The format is tested in the field, improved through feedback, and the results are shared at an international conference and local multiplier events.

etkinlik.wp2-a1-ihtiyac-analizi.ozet: A comprehensive, comparative scientific report analysing the current state of green, social and digital entrepreneurship in three partner countries. The findings provide an evidence-based foundation for project actions.
etkinlik.wp2-a2-ekitap.baslik: A-2. Innovative Pathways: GSD Entrepreneurship Good Practices E-Book
etkinlik.wp2-a2-ekitap.ozet: A unique open-access guide compiling innovative and transferable good practices in twin and social entrepreneurship. The e-book will serve as a practical reference for youth workers, academics and NGOs supporting youth entrepreneurship.
etkinlik.wp2-a3-acilis-toplantisi.ozet: Task allocation, introducing project partners and strengthening communication, reviewing activities and timelines, clarifying responsibilities and cooperation expectations, and explaining management and reporting processes.
etkinlik.wp2-a4-tpm2.ozet: Discussion of the work carried out under WP2 under the coordination of the leading country, assessment of progress against planned objectives, addressing implementation challenges, and agreeing on adjustments to ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
etkinlik.wp3-a1-proje-formati.baslik: A-1. Designing an Entrepreneurship Project Format for Skill-Development
etkinlik.wp3-a1-proje-formati.ozet: A comprehensive and transferable entrepreneurship project format will be developed to build basic skills in green, social and digital entrepreneurship. It guides users through problem identification, social relevance analysis and creative solution design.
etkinlik.wp3-a2-egitim-modulu.baslik: A-2. GSD Entrepreneurship Online Training Module
etkinlik.wp3-a2-egitim-modulu.ozet: An accessible, self-paced learning experience on green, social and digital entrepreneurship. Interactive content supports youth workers and young people in developing practical entrepreneurial skills.
etkinlik.wp3-a3-tpm3.ozet: Effective monitoring of WP3 progress, enabling partners to review achievements, address challenges and agree on strategic decisions for upcoming activities, strengthening coordination and alignment across the project.
etkinlik.wp3-a4-ltta.baslik: A-4. LTTA — Learning, Teaching and Training Activity
etkinlik.wp3-a4-ltta.ozet: Equips participants with practical skills to apply the entrepreneurship project format in youth work settings, enabling them to guide young people in developing feasible green, social and digital entrepreneurship projects.
etkinlik.wp3-a5-va1.ozet: A short virtual meeting in which partners jointly review the content developed so far, collect feedback and prepare for the next stage.
etkinlik.wp3-a6-tpm4.ozet: Ensures accurate project tracking, strengthens coordination among partners and finalises preparations for the implementation of training activities, ensuring readiness and alignment for the next phase.
etkinlik.wp4-a1-pilot.baslik: A-1. Piloting and Implementation of the Entrepreneurship Project Format
etkinlik.wp4-a1-pilot.ozet: The project format is piloted with participants to test its clarity, usability and effectiveness. Feedback identifies gaps and improvements, ensuring the format is practical, applicable and ready for use in youth entrepreneurship contexts.
etkinlik.wp4-a2-tpm5.ozet: Reviews the piloting results of the project format, identifies gaps and needed improvements, and ensures the necessary revisions are made to finalise a practical and effective tool for youth entrepreneurship work.
etkinlik.wp4-a3-va2.baslik: A-3. Virtual Activity-2 — GSD Entrepreneurship Final Review & Enhancement
etkinlik.wp4-a3-va2.ozet: Partners jointly review the GSD entrepreneurship outputs, collect final feedback and apply improvements. This ensures the materials are clear, relevant and ready for effective use in youth work practice.
etkinlik.wp4-a4-tpm6-final.baslik: A-4. TPM-6 and Final International Conference
etkinlik.wp4-a4-tpm6-final.ozet: TPM-6 and the Final International Conference disseminate project results to 26 participants at international level. Planning of local multiplier events ensures structured dissemination and wider impact across all partner countries.

klasor.giris: All project documents in one tree: twenty main folders from the contract to the final report. Each document lives in one place; if it also concerns another heading, a shortcut is added there.
klasor.ilke.numara: Folders are numbered 01_, 02_. Drive sorts alphabetically, so without numbers contract documents and templates get mixed up and partners upload files to the wrong place.
klasor.ilke.tek: Each document lives in a single folder. Having the same file in two places raises the question of which version is valid during the interim report. A document concerning more than one heading goes into the main folder, and a Drive shortcut is added to the other.
klasor.ilke.sorumluluk: Every main folder has an owner. Contract, budget and reporting folders stay with the coordinator, Ankara Hacı Bayram Veli University; in work package folders the relevant WP leader has upload rights.

etkinlik.resmi.silinmez: This is one of the official activities in the application form and cannot be deleted. If its details are wrong, correct them with Edit; if it will not take place, set its status to "Postponed".
etkinlik.resmi.silinmezOrtak: This is one of the official activities in the application form and cannot be deleted. You can update its status and link; if the date or title is wrong, the project manager corrects it.
cikti.giris: The preparation status, responsible organisation, delivery date and latest version in each language of every result. The public version is not on the platform but at the external address where the result is published.
cikti.masaBasi.metin: A systematic review of existing Erasmus+ Youth projects and sources that feeds the needs analysis.
cikti.araUrunNot: Interim product: not a public deliverable but internal work feeding the Needs Analysis Report. It does not count towards "Delivered results".
cikti.kodYok: No activity code in the application
cikti.yukleNot: Uploading a new file in the same language opens a new version; earlier ones are kept. The status becomes "In preparation" when the first file arrives.
cikti.takvimden: The responsible organisation and delivery date come from the production period in the calendar; edit that entry to change them.
cikti.hata.url: The address must start with http:// or https://.
cikti.hata.yetki: Only the responsible organisation and the project manager can change this result.
faaliyet.anket.secenekYok: There is no published form to link; prepare and publish the survey in Forms first.
faaliyet.hata.yetki: Only the lead organisation and the project manager can change the activity file.
faaliyet.hata.tur: This activity type has no such document.
faaliyet.hata.formBaska: This form is linked to another activity.
pano.giris: The work waiting for your organisation on one screen. Click a row to go to the record.
pano.yaklasan.bos: Your organisation has no activity or task in the next 60 days.
pano.eksikDosya.bos: The files of started activities are complete.
pano.ciktilar.bos: Your organisation is not responsible for a result.
pano.dosyalar.bos: Your organisation has not uploaded any files to the folders yet.
pano.genelNot: Visible to the project manager only. Red numbers need attention.
hatirlatici.etkinlik.durum: “%{baslik}” has ended but its status was not updated. If it took place, mark it “Completed”.
hatirlatici.cikti.durum: The delivery date of “%{baslik}” has passed. If it was delivered, update its status.
hatirlatici.durum.baskaKurum: %{n} activities or results in other organisations have an outdated status.
pano.durum.bos: Every finished activity and every result past its date has an up-to-date status.
ekip.uye.aday.yok: No account left to add in this organisation
ekip.uye.kisiIpucu: A team member is an account in the system and can only join the team of their own organisation. For someone not listed, the project manager first creates an account on the Users page.
ekip.hata.kisi: Choose a person from the list.
ekip.hata.baskaKurum: This person's account belongs to another organisation; they can only join their own organisation's team.
ekip.hata.zatenVar: This person is already in the team.
ekip.hata.silinmez: A team member cannot be removed from the team; they leave only when their account is deleted.
klasor.hata.bagli: This folder is linked to the activity file; you can only upload here, files cannot be moved in or shortcut here.
klasor.bagli.not: This folder is the “%{parca}” part of the activity file. A document uploaded here also appears on the activity in the calendar; do not upload it twice.
klasor.bagli.ac: Open the activity in the calendar →
klasor.bagli.dosyaNot: In the activity file; also shown on the activity in the calendar.
klasor.bagli.takvimden: This part is added from the activity in the calendar: photos go to the activity gallery, the survey is linked from Forms.
klasor.bagli.yetkiYok: Only the activity lead partner and the coordinator can upload here; send the document to them.
klasor.bosYok: No empty folders here; every folder has documents.
